svg.title: mla-convert
svg.desc: Converting a trained MHA or GQA model to MLA, Llama-2-7B per layer (32 heads × 128, d 4096). Step 1: keep RoPE on a few high-norm frequency pairs (MHA2MLA) or concentrate it in one head (TransMLA); the rest become NoPE. Step 2: joint SVD of the stacked NoPE key and value projections gives W_DKV (r × 4096) and the up-projections. Step 3: fine-tune with 0.3–0.6% of pre-training data (MHA2MLA) or 6B tokens (TransMLA). KV bytes per token and layer: MHA 16 KiB; MHA2MLA 5 KiB (−68.75%); with Int4 1.25 KiB (−92.19%); TransMLA 1,152 B (−92.97%).
